note: The PDF content stream 'BT /F1 0 Tf ...' supplies fontSize = 0 (Tf operand) into the graphics state; a zero font size makes the font transform matrix all-zero.
fontSize == 0 makes the font-matrix elements m21 (and m22 on the next line) exactly zero, so the textMat passed to the font engine is the null matrix.
The all-zero font matrix is handed to SplashFTFontFile::makeFont, which constructs the SplashFTFont with textMat[2] == textMat[3] == 0.

textScale = splashDist(0,0,textMat[2],textMat[3])/size == 0, so the div-by-zero bugfix guard triggers the early 'return;' and the constructor exits before initializing the FT_Matrix members matrix and textMatrix.

Because of the early return in the constructor, the heap-allocated FT_Matrix member 'matrix' (and 'textMatrix') is never assigned, leaving it uninitialized while the font object is still cached and used for glyph rendering.

makeGlyph passes the uninitialized FT_Matrix to FT_Set_Transform, whose identity check reads matrix->xy/yx/xx/yy; this is the use of uninitialized data (MSan use-of-uninitialized-value) reported in SplashFTFont::makeGlyph.
